title: Very Poor Smooth-Edge Can Opener—Requires Far Too Much Hand Strength
text:
Very Poor Smooth-Edge Can Opener—Requires Far Too Much Hand Strength. Once you’ve tried a good “lid-lifter” can opener, you won’t want to use a “lid-cutter” can opener ever again. The “smooth edge” lid-lifters pull the entire lid off the can—the lid is held on with adhesive—leaving no sharp edges around the lid to cut you when the can is opened. Unfortunately, this SWING-A-WAY SMOOTH EDGE CAN OPENER (522448; 7.5”, Black) is NOT one of the good ones. It requires far too much hand strength to twist the knob and propel the opener around the can.

This is actually the first Swing-a-Way opener that I haven’t liked, and I’m really surprised that it’s so hard to use. Two very good lid-lifter openers are the battery-operated [[ASIN:B00QHPOHSS Bartelli Soft Edge Can Opener]], and the manual [[ASIN:B000079XW2 OXO Smooth Edge Can Opener]]. My stroke-disabled husband (who is one-handed but still cooks) uses the Bartelli opener every day, because it opens cans reliably, without the need to twist any knobs.

This Swing-a-Way smooth edge opener might be a good substitute for one of those hand-squeeze devices that athletes use to strengthen their hand grip.

product_metadata.title: Swing-A-Way Smooth Edge Can Opener, 7.5", Black
features: NO SHARP EDGES: This can opener is uniquely crafted to safely and precisely separate the lid from the can, without creating sharp edges; works on all cans, including pop-tops.

EFFORTLESSLY OPENS CANS: The easy to use, no-squeeze cutting design allows the blade to set onto the lip on the can and cuts around the side, leaving no sharp edges on the can or lid; the blade never touches the food.

HIGH QUALITY: Features a high-carbon steel, gear-driven cutting wheel and skip-proof feed for smooth and easy usage; also features a large knob for easier turning, which is perfect for just about anyone to handle.

SINGLE HANDELED DESIGN: Features a comfortable, ergonomic grip single handle design, (no second, swing handle) that is crafted from durable, BPA-Free, 100% food safe plastic; no strenuous gripping and squeezing required.
description: One of the biggest drawbacks of using canned products is the risk of cutting your fingers on the sharp edges left by can openers. But now Swing-A-Way makes those rough edges a thing of the past with the Smooth-Edge Can Opener. The smart design of this device has it open cans from the side and not the top. Once the rotation around the can is complete, simply remove the top with a slight twisting motion. There’s no need to “dig” in to remove it. Best of all, the smooth-edge technology works on all types of cans, including pop-tops.
